Name: Sekun's Crop Expansion
Author: RiftstalkerSekun
Description:
Have you ever wanted just a little bit more variety in your farm fields? Just a handful of new options per season, nothing too overwhelming? Do you think that the Dehydrator is criminally under-utilized? If the answer to any of the above is yes, then you're in good company.

I often found myself frozen by analysis paralysis just looking at the larger, more comprehensive crop mods, and wanting more from the smaller, single crop mods. So I decided to remedy that problem by creating my own. This mod adds 5 new crops per season to Pierre's shop, along with 6 Winter crops, for a total of twenty one new crops to grow! In addition, Sandy sells four new seeds to grow various herbs and spices for the Dehydrator, one for each season, with Pierre selling one lone spice seed variety in Spring.

Some crops will grow across multiple seasons, some are regrowth crops, and a handful are only available starting in Year 2. Crops were also balanced against already existing vanilla crops, to ensure that none are too over or underpowered. Nothing stronger than Starfruit, nothing weaker than Parsnips. And to keep with the realism and theming of Stardew Valley's vanilla crops, all additional crops are real existing plants, no Junimo magic or other strangeness going on. It's also just the crops, no recipes to worry about! Just relax and plant.


Spring Crops
Pierre: [spoiler]Cucumber, Green Cabbage (Year 2), Heirloom Carrot, Mangosteen (Year 2), Red Onion. The bonus spice is Peppercorns![/spoiler]
Sandy: [spoiler]Thyme[/spoiler]

Summer Crops
Pierre: [spoiler]Collard Greens, Fennel, Kohlrabi, Watermelon, Zucchini (Year 2)[/spoiler]
Sandy: [spoiler]Rosemary[/spoiler]

Fall Crops
Pierre: [spoiler]Asparagus, Butternut Squash (Year 2), Rainbow Chard, Rutabaga, Yellow Onion[/spoiler]
Sandy: [spoiler]Cinnamon[/spoiler]

Winter Crops
Pierre: [spoiler]Celeriac, Rose Hips, Snow Pea, Spinach, Winter Cabbage, Winter Gourd[/spoiler]
Sandy: [spoiler]Saffron[/spoiler]
